defs.aiUsd: spot, busiest AI/USDG venue, last hourly close
defs.feeAnnual: AI/yr, trailing 7 complete days annualised, all three splitter legs
defs.feeTrend: fee run-rate this 7 complete days vs the prior 7, as a fraction
defs.leak: share of AI volume NOT on AI/NVDA (pays AI's vault nothing), LAST COMPLETE DAY, days with both kinds only. Rows before 2026-10-06 carry the older hookless share, which continues as leakNoHook
defs.leakNoHook: share of AI volume on pools without LONG's hook (pays LONG nothing), LAST COMPLETE DAY, days with both kinds only
defs.capture: AI/NVDA share of AI volume, LAST COMPLETE DAY (the site's card uses a 7-day aggregate, so it differs)
defs.kappa: cross-routed vs direct AI, trailing window set by the routing task
defs.nvdaPerDay: NVDA into the vault, trailing 7 complete days, per day
defs.removedPerDay: AI burned + locked, trailing 7 complete days, per day
defs.net7: net AI bought minus sold, trailing 7 complete days, all indexed pools
defs.organicShare: flow-weighted AI-pair share of organic bridges; null when bridges.json is over 8h old
defs.depthImbalance: USD bids minus asks within +/-50% of spot, all indexed venues
defs.nearBid: USD of quote within 2% below spot
defs.nearAsk: USD of AI within 2% above spot
defs.holders: addresses with a non-zero AI balance at the last four-hour snapshot, machinery excluded
defs.holders100k: addresses holding at least 100,000 AI at that snapshot (price-neutral breadth)
defs.top10Share: share of holder-owned AI held by the 10 largest wallets
defs.newHolders24h: addresses funded from zero over the last six snapshots (24h)
defs.exits24h: addresses emptied to zero over the same window
defs.buyers7d: wallets that net-bought AI through a pool per day (netted per transaction, summed over six 4h periods), trailing 7 complete days average
defs.volumeUsd24h: AI volume on indexed venues over the last complete day, priced hour by hour in USDG
defs.nvdaUsd: NVDA in dollars from its busiest USDG venue; null when prices.json is over 8h old
defs.stockShare: (DEX inventory + vault) / on-chain supply of Robinhood stock tokens, dollar-weighted over priced tokens; null when rwa.json is over 8h old
defs.stockSwapShare: share of the last day's swaps touching a stock token that went through a LONG-hook pool
defs.stockDexUsd: USD of stock tokens held by the v4 pool manager, all venues
defs.tvlUsd: USD value of every resting position in AI's indexed venues at spot
defs.hookTvlUsd: the part of tvlUsd held by the LONG hook's own positions
defs.sell1m: AI price move from a $1M sale routed across all indexed venues, as a fraction (1 = book exhausted)
